P01.proposed_action: Verify invoice 2027-4471 and its payment status with the payment approver. Check any bank details against the contract on file, not against the email.
P01.reply_body: Thank you for your reminder. We will check the status of invoice 2027-4471 and come back to you with confirmed payment timing once it is available.

P02.proposed_action: Check that the attached invoice 10023 arrived in the original email, log it and confirm receipt to the supplier.
P02.reply_body: Благодарим за изпратената фактура 10023. Ще проверим дали е получена и ще Ви уведомим, ако е необходимо да я изпратите отново.

P03.proposed_action: Ask Security to check queue and open-lane records for the morning of 28 February.
P03.reply_body: I am sorry about the long wait at security and that you nearly missed your flight. We will ask the team to review the queue and lane staffing around your departure on flight FR1234 and let you know what we can confirm.

P04.proposed_action: Identify the flight and ask the handler to review baggage delivery to belt 2.
P04.reply_body: Съжаляваме за дългото чакане и липсата на информация. Моля, посочете номера на полета и датата на пристигане, за да проверим случая с наземния оператор.

P05.proposed_action: Check the lost-property log for a black laptop charger found near gate B4 on the previous evening.
P05.reply_body: We will check whether a black laptop charger was handed in near gate B4. If you can, please share its brand or any other identifying feature, and your flight number.

P06.proposed_action: Check the café and terminal lost-property records for glasses with brown frames.
P06.reply_body: Ще проверим дали са предадени очила с кафяви рамки в района на кафенето след проверката за сигурност. Ако помните кое е кафенето или има отличителен белег на очилата, моля, съобщете ни.

P07.proposed_action: Check remote stand and ground power availability for 4 March at 06:40 and obtain duty approval before confirming.
P07.reply_body: Thank you for your request. We will check stand and ground power availability for the requested window. Please send the flight identifier and the aircraft type.

P08.proposed_action: Review seasonal check-in desk capacity with the airline and confirm the right contact for the formal request.
P08.reply_body: Please send the effective dates and the flight schedule so we can assess the request for two additional check-in desks between 04:30 and 07:00 on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We will also confirm who should receive the formal request.

P09.proposed_action: Route confidentially to the designated personnel contact to verify the leave balance and the applicable deadline.
P09.reply_body: Ще проверим условията за пренасяне на неизползвания отпуск и срока за ползването му. Ще Ви отговорим по служебния канал.

P10.proposed_action: Record the Thursday 17:00 deadline and clear the passenger figures and any management comment for release before replying with content.
P10.reply_body: Thank you for your request. We have noted your Thursday 17:00 deadline and will confirm which figures and comments are available for publication.

P11.proposed_action: No reply needed now: log the VoxAI pitch and review it if a relevant sourcing need arises.

P12.proposed_action: No reply needed now: log the proposal and screen it with Technical/Infrastructure against planned facilities projects. Check the attached company profile in the original email.

P13.proposed_action: Inspect the escalator to gate A12 during this shift and log the fault. Coordinate signage and an accessible route with Terminal Operations.
P13.reply_body: Благодарим за сигнала за неработещия ескалатор до изход A12. Ще проверим съоръжението и ще уточним с екипа на терминала кой достъпен маршрут могат да ползват пътниците.

P14.proposed_action: Ask Finance to reconcile booking 88231 and the barrier transaction before any refund decision.
P14.reply_body: We are sorry for the trouble you had at the barrier. We will review booking 88231 and both charges. If you can, please send the barrier ticket number and the dates of the two charges.

P15.proposed_action: Identify the taxi operator at the Terminal 2 rank and ask Commercial to check the fare complaint.
P15.reply_body: Съжаляваме за неприятното преживяване. Моля, изпратете датата и приблизителния час на пътуването, както и снимка на касовата бележка или регистрационния номер на таксито, ако ги имате.

P16.proposed_action: Coordinate the arrival handoff with the operating airline and advise the sender how to book assistance.
P16.reply_body: Wheelchair assistance is arranged through your father's airline, so please request it from them for his 19 March arrival. If you share the flight number, we can help confirm the arrival arrangements.

P17.proposed_action: Check feasibility of the 04:30 delivery slot with Terminal Operations and obtain Security clearance before any change.
P17.reply_body: Thank you for your request. We will check whether a 04:30 slot is possible and confirm the approval process. Please share the requested start date and delivery days.

P18.proposed_action: Open a support ticket and reconcile the manually submitted sales files with Commercial.
P18.reply_body: Ще проверим автоматичното подаване на данните и дали ръчно изпратените файлове са получени. Моля, посочете кога е било последното успешно подаване и дали системата показва грешка.

P19.proposed_action: Check whether published sources answer the questions and whether a staff response is available.
P19.reply_body: Thank you for your interest. Please send your five questions and your deadline, and we will check whether a colleague can respond or whether published information answers them.

P20.proposed_action: Report through the internal ICT channel, preserve the original and check whether anyone interacted with it. Keep the link unopened.
P20.reply_body: We received a suspected phishing email, claiming to come from an IT service desk, saying that the mailbox will be deactivated within 24 hours and asking recipients to verify their credentials through a link. Please review the original through the internal reporting channel and check whether anyone has interacted with it.

P21.proposed_action: Link this message to the same sender's earlier reminder about invoice 2027-4471 and prepare one coordinated update for human review.
P21.reply_body: Thank you for following up. We will check whether invoice 2027-4471 was received by our finance department and include that confirmation in our update.

P22.proposed_action: Alert the duty lead immediately, verify that the temporary markings are effective, arrange approved cleanup of the oil spill at position 7 and log the incident. Have the duty lead confirm clearance before normal use resumes.

P23.proposed_action: Explain how to submit the EU261 claim to the airline that operated the flight and help identify its claims channel if needed.
P23.reply_body: Thank you for your message. Compensation claims under EU261 are handled by the airline that operated your flight, so please submit your claim to that airline. If you share the flight number, we can help you find the right claims channel.

P24.proposed_action: Ask Security to review the interaction once the checkpoint and time are known.
P24.reply_body: Съжаляваме за неприятното преживяване на проверката за сигурност. Моля, посочете датата, приблизителния час и терминала, за да можем да проверим случая.

P25.proposed_action: Search lost-property reports for a brown teddy bear near gate A9.
P25.reply_body: We are sorry to hear about the lost teddy bear and will check whether it was handed in near gate A9. If you can, please send your flight number and describe any distinctive markings.

P26.proposed_action: Check the current status of belt 3 with the handler, review the fault records for both stoppages and see whether upcoming flights are affected.
P26.reply_body: Thank you for the report. We will check whether belt 3 is operating normally and review both stoppages, and we will share our findings once they are confirmed.

P27.proposed_action: Check the contractual due date and confirm the payment status with the payment approver.
P27.reply_body: Ще проверим договорения срок и статуса на фактура 2027-0091 и ще Ви уведомим, когато разполагаме с потвърдена информация за плащането.

P28.proposed_action: Route confidentially to the designated recruitment contact.
P28.reply_body: Thank you for your follow-up. We will check the status of the Maintenance Technician vacancy and your application with the recruitment contact.

P29.proposed_action: Assess the revenue-share proposal against the airport's advertising plans and coordinate any concession implications with Commercial.
P29.reply_body: Thank you for your proposal. Please send a short overview of the revenue-share model and any space and installation requirements, and we will pass it to the right team.

P30.proposed_action: Check the current liquids rules for transfer passengers with Security and point the passenger to Vienna Airport for confirmation.
P30.reply_body: Препоръчваме при покупката да поискате парфюмът да бъде запечатан в защитна торба заедно с касовата бележка и да не го отваряте до крайната си дестинация. Правилата при прекачване зависят от летището на трансфер, затова моля, проверете актуалните изисквания на летище Виена преди пътуването.

P31.proposed_action: Ask the relevant concessionaire to verify the pharmacy location and Friday evening opening hours.
P31.reply_body: Thank you for your question. Which terminal are you departing from? We will check whether there is a pharmacy after security and confirm its opening hours for Friday evening.

P32.proposed_action: Check the EUR 1,100 deduction on invoice 884/2027 with the contract owner and involve Legal if the contract interpretation is disputed.
P32.reply_body: We will review the EUR 1,100 deduction on invoice 884/2027 and follow up once we have verified the basis for it.

P33.proposed_action: Send cleaning and maintenance to restock soap, secure the defective cubicles and verify the repair.
P33.reply_body: Благодарим за сигнала за тоалетната до изход B10 на Терминал 2. Ще предадем на екипа на терминала да провери заключването на кабините и да зареди сапун.

P34.proposed_action: Obtain approved technical input from Terminal Operations and reply through the formal procurement channel if a tender is active.
P34.reply_body: Thank you for your message. We will confirm the appropriate channel for your scope questions and share any approved clarification through it.

P35.proposed_action: Check the filming window and location with Terminal Operations and Security before any permission is issued.
P35.reply_body: Thank you for your request. We will review your filming request for 11 March between 09:00 and 11:00. Please send your planned shots and equipment list so we can confirm the approval process.

P36.proposed_action: Check terminal records promptly and coordinate with Security on handing over any found document.
P36.reply_body: Ще проверим за намерен паспорт в зоната между проверката за сигурност и изход A6. Тъй като пътувате в петък, моля, още днес се свържете с летищната полиция и с органа, издал документа, за указания.

P37.proposed_action: No reply needed now: log the offer and involve ICT if a licensing review is underway.

P38.proposed_action: Ask the airline or handler for dispatch records and start a same-shift review because of the reported health impact.
P38.reply_body: I am sorry to hear about the long wait and the distress it caused your wife. Please share the flight number and the arrival date so we can review the assistance arrangements.

P39.proposed_action: Verify the start date and obtain approvals for email and CMMS access before provisioning.
P39.reply_body: Ще регистрираме заявка за служебна поща и достъп до CMMS. Моля, изпратете по вътрешния канал потвърждение за началната дата и одобрената роля в CMMS.

P40.proposed_action: Have a reviewer check the original email for a callback number and ask for enough detail to route the case.
P40.reply_body: Thank you for your message. Could you briefly describe what happened and where at the airport it took place? If you would like a callback, please confirm the best number to reach you.
